title: Evaluation
summary: Defines repository validation and the local 70-point benchmark: three fixtures by three runs, independent rubric scoring, no automatic fails, median at least 70, minimum 65, under ten minutes, and deterministic risk/effort/Gate checks. compact生成、予算・usage、証跡版の契約はefficient-generation.mdを参照。 batched生成・設計状態・比較再検証はspec-06とAC-20260910-batched.mdを参照。 要件定義信頼度・要確認集計・根拠付き再評価はrequirements-confidence.mdとspec-07を参照。
